name: 12_Client_Care_Letter.pdf
summary: Client care letter and terms of engagement signed by Joe Bloggs (16 October 2024).

overlayBoxes.title: Terms Permit Disclosure of Material Facts to the Lender
overlayBoxes.details: The client care letter explains the firm's duties when acting for the lender and records the client's consent to disclosures to the lender where required.

overlayBoxes.title: Client Care Letter Gives Written Fee Estimate
overlayBoxes.details: The client care letter sets out the terms of instruction and gives an itemised written estimate of legal fees, VAT, disbursements, and the estimated total.

overlayBoxes.title: Client Is Told About Fee Arrangements
overlayBoxes.details: The client care letter explains the fee arrangements, including how fees and disbursements will be paid from completion monies or invoiced if the transaction does not proceed.

overlayBoxes.title: Client Is Told About Changes to Costs
overlayBoxes.details: The client care letter says the firm will advise promptly if estimated costs change before additional fees are incurred.

overlayBoxes.title: Complaints Procedure Is Given in Writing
overlayBoxes.details: The client care letter explains the client's right to complain, who the complaint should be sent to, and the expected response timeframe.

overlayBoxes.title: Legal Ombudsman Escalation Details Are Provided
overlayBoxes.details: The client care letter gives Legal Ombudsman escalation rights, contact details, and time limits.

overlayBoxes.title: Payment Arrangements Are Explained to the Client
overlayBoxes.details: The client care letter records that fees and disbursements will be paid from completion monies on completion, or directly by the client within 28 days if the transaction does not proceed.
